therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: coronary thrombus dissolution and myocardial reperfusion
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: STEMI patients unable to undergo primary PCI within guideline-recommended time
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: composite of all-cause mortality, cardiogenic shock, congestive heart failure, and recurrent myocardial infarction within 30 days

safety_signals: Higher total stroke rate in tenecteplase arm (RR 3.01, 95% CI 1.10–8.24, p=0.032)
Higher intracranial haemorrhage rate in tenecteplase arm (9 vs 2, RR 4.51, p=0.054)
Higher non-disabling stroke rate in tenecteplase arm (RR 8.02, p=0.049)
Higher major non-intracranial bleeding in tenecteplase arm (61 vs 45, RR 1.36, p=0.111)
Lower rate of serious resuscitated ventricular fibrillation associated with invasive procedures in tenecteplase arm (RR 0.35, p=0.003)

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Enoxaparin prevents re-thrombosis after tenecteplase-mediated fibrinolysis, sustaining coronary patency achieved by thrombolysis
modulation_entries.citation: Adjunctive treatment with enoxaparin was administered alongside tenecteplase as part of the pharmacoinvasive reperfusion strategy

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Clopidogrel inhibits platelet aggregation to prevent re-occlusion of the infarct-related artery after tenecteplase-mediated fibrinolysis
modulation_entries.citation: Adjunctive treatment with clopidogrel was administered alongside tenecteplase as part of the pharmacoinvasive reperfusion strategy
